The scatterplot shows the relationship between the age, in weeks, of each of $9$ chickens on June 15 and the number of eggs each chicken laid that week. How many eggs did the $8$-week chicken lay?
explanation: Choice D is correct. To determine how many eggs the $8$-week chicken laid, locate the value $8$ on the horizontal axis (age in weeks), then find the corresponding data point directly above it on the scatterplot. Reading the vertical coordinate of this point on the y-axis shows that the $8$-week-old chicken laid $3$ eggs that week. Since there is only one data point at age $8$ weeks, this can be read directly from the graph without ambiguity.
